Name: Evelyn is Mrs. Doubtfire
Author: SterlingDraven
Description:
[center][/center][center][size=4][/size][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/6OgsH5M.png[/img]﻿
﻿[size=4][b][i]HELLOOO![/i][/b][/size]

﻿[size=3]And welcome to yet another Robin Williams-inspired mod! This time it's none other than hip-hoppin', bebopin' Granny herself!  So grab a cup o' cocoa, and settle in for the cozy nostalgia that is Euphegenia Doubtfire.[/size][/center]

First, some things to note:
﻿This mod uses Content Patcher to only overwrite Evelyn's name, dialogue (only when you first meet her), and character sprite and portrait sheets. It isn't a total overhaul or character replacer by any means. (I gave it a shot, but it didn't really work out.) That being said, if someone out there is up to the task, by all means, have at it. I leave it to you!

﻿Second, you may notice that Evelyn's name hasn't been overwritten in your game. This is likely due to an unforeseen conflict with a mod that also edits character dialogue (i.e. "Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion"*). If this is the case, please report it to the Bugs tab, and I'll try to address it as quickly as possible.


[b][color=#ffd966]Installation:[/color][/b]
- Be sure to have the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed
- Download this mod and unzip it to your mods folder (Stardew Valley/Mods)
﻿~ Avoid using using mod managers, such as Vortex, for Stardew Valley mods. It tends to only complicate things.
- Run the game and enjoy!

[color=#ffd966][size=2][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color]
*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url][size=2]﻿: Should work fine, please let me know otherwise.[/size]

[color=#ffd966][size=2][b]Bugs and Error Reporting:[/b][/size][/color]
If for any reason you have issues with this mod, please report them to the Bugs tab.

And remember:

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/9QxIxq9.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][center][size=3][b][i]You're only given a little spark of madness. You mustn't lose it.[/i][/b][i]
~ Robin Williams[/i][/size][/center]
